cues.en: Hello.
Hello, good evening.

cues.zh: 我是 Ismo，没错，我来自芬兰。
cues.en: I am Ismo, and yes, I am from Finland.
Yay, yay, yay.

cues.zh: 我大约一年前搬到了美国，
cues.en: I moved to America about a year ago,
and it's been great,
but I have to tell you that it took

cues.zh: 很长时间才学会那些东西，
cues.en: a long time to learn the things,

cues.zh: 比如那些细微的小细节。
cues.en: like the small, subtle things.
It took me a year to figure out
that the correct answer to, "What's up?"
is "What's up?"

cues.zh: 花了很久，但现在我懂了。
cues.en: It took a long time, but now, I know.
If somebody says, "What's up?"
I just say, "What's up?"

cues.zh: 感觉怪怪的，好像我没在回答问题，
cues.en: It feels wrong, like I feel I'm not answering a question,

cues.zh: 但他们挺开心，那我就一直这么干。
cues.en: but they are happy, so I just keep doing it.
It took me even longer than that

cues.zh: 才终于明白，“Can I help you?”
cues.en: to finally learn that, "Can I help you?"
actually means, "Go away."

cues.zh: 我一直在学，但我觉得语言
cues.en: I'm always learning, but I think the language
still has been the most difficult part,

cues.zh: 因为我学了好多年英语，
cues.en: 'cause I studied English for years,
and I thought I know English,

cues.zh: 结果一搬到美国就傻眼了。
cues.en: but then, I moved to America.
Turns out, no.

cues.zh: 我其实并不了解，所有那些东西。
cues.en: I didn't really know it, all the things.

cues.zh: 我觉得最难真正掌握的单词
cues.en: I think the hardest word to truly master
has been the word ass.
Ass.
I thought it's really easy.

cues.zh: 它的意思是屁股，但并不是。
cues.en: It means a butt, but no.

cues.zh: 比如，是的，有时候它可以指屁股，
cues.en: Like, yeah, sometimes it can mean a butt,

cues.zh: 但那只是ass这座冰山的尖尖一角。
cues.en: but that's just the tip of the ass-berg.
There are so many meanings to the word ass.

cues.zh: 我觉得它是英语中最复杂的单词。
cues.en: I think it's the most complicated word in English.

cues.zh: 我一直想写一整本词典
cues.en: I've been trying to write a whole dictionary
about just ass.
There's so many, for example, lazy ass.
That means lazy.
Like, "My lazy ass husband."
It's the same sentence without the ass.
The ass is just optional there.
And long-ass means long.

cues.zh: 比如一趟long-ass航班，就是一趟长途航班。
cues.en: Like a long-ass flight, it's a long flight.
But if you're gonna make it longer,
you're gonna add ass.

cues.zh: 我最喜欢的一个，a grown-ass man。
cues.en: My definite favorite one, a grown-ass man.

cues.zh: 原来它指的是成年男人。
cues.en: It turns out it means a grown man.
The entire man has grown,
not only his ass.

cues.zh: 我学到的是，你可以在任何词后面加 ass，
cues.en: I learned that you can add ass to anything,
and then it sounds a little bit cooler.

cues.zh: 比如任何东西，“我刚买了这件蓝色-ass 衬衫。”
cues.en: Like anything, "I just bought this blue-ass shirt."
"Well, thank you, that was some good-ass meatballs."

cues.zh: 任何词都行，但你得小心，
cues.en: Anything, but you have to be careful,

cues.zh: 因为有时候，你在某个词后面加 ass，
cues.en: 'cause sometimes, if you add ass to something,
it can actually reverse the meaning
of the original word.
For example, badass.
That's good.

cues.zh: Bad 是坏，但 badass 是好。
cues.en: Bad is bad, but badass is good.
But not always.
Like, dumbass is still dumb.
How could you know?
You have to know specifically
which ones are flipped.

cues.zh: 然后还有“your ass”这个概念，
cues.en: And then there's the concept of your ass,

cues.zh: your ass 意思是你自己。
cues.en: and your ass, that means yourself.
Like, "Move your ass!"
That's like move everything.

cues.zh: 动起来，你的屁股和身体其他部位，全都动起来。
cues.en: Move your ass and the rest of your body and everything.

cues.zh: 如果你有辆车，那也算在你的屁股里。
cues.en: If you have a car, that's included in the ass.

cues.zh: 全都朝同一个方向，动起来就行。
cues.en: All of them, same direction, just move.

cues.zh: 所以你的屁股指的是你自己加上你拥有的一切，
cues.en: So your ass means yourself plus all you have,

cues.zh: 但我的屁股，我的屁股，那可不是这个意思。
cues.en: but my ass, my ass, that means no.
If I say that, "Wow, this car is really fast,"
and you say, "Oh, fast, my ass."
It means no, it's not fast.
To make it even more complicated,
ass can be divided.
If you are an ass, that means
that you are being stupid,
but if you're half-ass-
Then, it means that you are
not concentrating properly.
And if you go even smaller,

cues.zh: 如果你是a piece of ass——那你很漂亮。
cues.en: if you are a piece of ass- Then, you are beautiful.
Thanks a lot.
